title: Squared norm after a constant shift
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$ have uniform mean zero, and let $\theta\in\mathbb{R}$. Then the squared uniform $L^2$ norm of $X-\theta$ is the squared uniform $L^2$ norm of $X$ plus $\theta^2$.
